name: helldivers2endgame
description: Helldivers 2 Endgame: an unofficial economic endgame mode. Players buy every loadout with Requisition; prices are set by a community-driven market.

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:api & npm run dev
scripts.build:release: H2E_RELEASE=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=/ npm run build -w frontend && node frontend/scripts/release-check.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p engine && node --test engine/dist/test/*.test.js && npm test -w backend
